notes.accounting: Exact integer charges and rational trapezoid debt-time, matching Phase12. Statistical intervals use floating-point 999 circular 14-calendar-day joint block draws seed20261018; no hypothesis selection.
notes.redesign: Observed debt and admissible projected-average inputs held fixed. Only upward premature fees redesigned. Not new equilibrium or capitalization replay. Periods telescope; monetary amounts generally do not. Same-block elapsed zero gives zero new upward fee and is an economic anti-churn concern.
notes.filter: Suppression-only at recorded timestamps, no automatic deferred transaction. Downward proposals accepted. Historic executed actions are used as a selected proposal stream, not the complete latent policy. Fee diagnostic holds original basis and branch-average inputs fixed; gas, new redemptions and counterfactual debt are not identified. Not a deployable permission/transaction bot.
notes.episodes: Maximal upward runs, >=2 steps, adjacent gaps <7 days; total span unrestricted. Crossing sample-boundary episodes omitted from per-sample episode totals. Fixed observed debt makes incremental management fee zero; actual changed capitalization/management liabilities and first-jump projected-average fee are NOT IDENTIFIED. Limited balance is not full dominance.
notes.queue: Higher numeric rate weakly improves the rate-only rank interval. Exact tie position, oracle eligibility, redemption outcome, permission feasibility and strategic response are not guaranteed.
